'''Ares Jansen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he was on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], when a centuries-old lethal plague was released during the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] and infected escaped [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]], making them the perfect carries for the disease. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Brenna Fash]] asked a Republic operative to cure the Gen'Dai while officer Jansen advised simply killing them instead.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Officer Jansen appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Belsavis, who starts the mission "The Perfect Carrier: Killing Gen'Dai."
